question: For each department that is degree granting, not Chemistry (Course 5), and has at least 100 total enrolled students in subjects it offers, what is the department name, the total number of enrolled students in its subjects, and, if the department is in the School of Engineering (excluding Management, Course 15), what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject it offered in the 2019FA term and the name of that subject with the maximum enrollment? Do not return any rounded answers.
sql: WITH dept_total_enrolled AS ( SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC ), eng_dept_max_enrollment AS ( SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0 ) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, edm.max_enrollment, edm.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_total_enrolled dte LEFT JOIN eng_dept_max_enrollment edm ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = edm.DEPARTMENT_NAME;
column_mapping: {"department name": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME"], "degree granting": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING"], "Chemistry (Course 5)": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"], "total number of enrolled students": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS"], "subjects it offers": ["SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY.OFFER_DEPT_CODE", "TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_CODE"], "School of Engineering": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME"], "Management (Course 15)": ["SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE"], "maximum number of enrolled students in any subject": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS"], "subject name with the maximum enrollment": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_TITLE"], "2019FA term": ["TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE"]}
domain_knowledge: ["\"Chemistry\" is predicated by \"TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'\"", "\"degree-granting\" is predicated by \"TABLE.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'\"", "\"Course 5\" is predicated by \"TABLE.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry'\"", "\"Chemistry\" is predicated by \"TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '5'\"", "\"Course 15\" is predicated by \"UPPER(TABLE.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MANAGEMENT'\"", "\"Management\" is predicated by \"TABLE.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15'\""]
sub_questions: ["For each department, give the department name and calculate the total number of enrolled students in subjects offered by departments that are degree granting, have at least 100 total enrolled students, and are not the Chemistry department (Course 5).", "For each department in the School of Engineering, what is the maximum number of enrolled students in any subject offered by that department in the term 2019FA, what is the name of the subject with that maximum enrollment, and restrict the results to only degree-granting departments and exclude the Department of Management (Course 15)?"]
